trap-superlative.notes: Unqualified maximum-strength claims that the block's own arguments do not support: 'The neutrino is strictly stable. It cannot decay via any process.' and 'T_{3,5} is the unique cross-family mediator.' Argument 2 supplies only 'strongly suppressing the channel' and the closing line only 'energetic inaccessibility' - suppression and inaccessibility are not impossibility, so the block contradicts itself within eight lines. This is also the AGENTS.md refuted/ruled-out scope rule: 'cannot' is a scope-(b) structural exclusion and needs a named proved invariant. NOT applied - weakening the claim changes the physics assertion. Proposed: 'The neutrino has no accessible decay channel' plus scope-(a) phrasing on item 2, or cite the invariant that forbids the channel outright.
